blocks.title: Half-life
blocks.text: Half-life, t1/2, woh waqt hai jo kisi reactant ki concentration ko apni asal qeemat ke aadhe tak girne mein lagta hai.

Half-life ke tareeqe se k nikalne ka matlab reactant ki concentration aadhi hone ka waqt napna hai. Pehle order ki reaction ke liye rate constant aur half-life k = 0.693 / t1/2 se jure hain. Pehle order ki reaction se toot-te hydrogen peroxide ke namoone ki half-life 2 ghante hai: seconds mein badlein, 2 x 60 x 60 = 7200 s, phir k = 0.693 / 7200 = 9.6 x 10^-5 s-1. Sample Problem 7.2: cyclopropane ka propene mein pehle order ka badalna 17.0 min ki half-life rakhta hai; seconds mein badlein, 17 x 60 = 1020 s, phir k = 0.693 / 1020 = 6.79 x 10^-4 s-1 (print units dm3 mol-1 s-1 likhti hai, jo doosre order ki hain).

blocks.alt: Pehle order ki reaction ka curve: [A] banam waqt. Concentration c0 se girti hai; t-half par c0/2, 2 t-half par c0/4 aur 3 t-half par c0/8 hoti hai, dashed lakeerein yeh qeematein dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Pehle order ki reaction mein har half-life ke baad concentration aadhi (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle order ki reaction mein half-life concentration par munhasir nahi: har t-half ke baad jo bacha hai us ka aadha reh jata hai. Teen half-lives ke baad sirf 1/8 bachta hai.

blocks.prompt: Pehle order ki reaction ki half-life 15 minute aur initial concentration 0.100 mol dm-3 hai. k nikalein, aur concentration ke 0.0125 mol dm-3 tak girne ka waqt.
blocks.explanation: k = 0.693 / (15 x 60) = 0.693 / 900 = 7.7 x 10^-4 s-1 (0.046 min-1). 0.100 se 0.0125 teen baar aadha hona hai (0.050, 0.025, 0.0125), to 3 x 15 = 45 minute; initial concentration k par asar nahi karti.

items: Half-life: reactant ke aadha hone ka waqt; pehla order: k = 0.693 / t1/2 (H2O2, 2 h = 7200 s, k = 9.6 x 10^-5 s-1; cyclopropane, 17 min, k = 6.79 x 10^-4 s-1).
